classes.name: FunctionalInverses
classes.description: A struct providing static methods to compute inverses of certain tensor view operations, such as chunk and narrow, used in functionalization workflows.

methods.name: chunk_inverse
methods.description: Computes the inverse operation for chunk, reconstructing the original tensor from a mutated view.
